description: Read-only GitHub PR status, using a plugin-owned GitHub token and the session's explicit PR association.

refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between automatic GitHub status checks, including hidden tabs. Defaults to 120; supported range is 30 to 86400.

notes: Repository and PR number belong to the session association, not tab configuration.
Set the association in the Pull request UI or with the session pull-request CLI command.
refreshIntervalSeconds defaults to 120; supported range is 30 to 86400 seconds.
label: Pull request
